item.title: Telin Launches ignitePRO at BATIC 2026, Turning Enterprise AI Ambition into Action
item.summary: PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia International (Telin) officially launched ignitePRO, a new enterprise-focused forum held as part of the Bali Annual Telkom International Conference (BATIC) 2026. Under the theme “The Enabled Enterprise,” ignitePRO brought together enterprise leaders, policymakers, technology providers, investors, and digital ecosystem partners to explore how AI can move beyond ambition and into real-world implementation.
